title: Mud in the Cauldron
description: Turn dirt into mud using a cauldron — no swamp hunting required.
body:
Mud is a great building material, but gathering it in bulk can be a hassle. This plugin lets you craft mud right at your base: simply hold dirt in your hand and right-click a water cauldron.

A simple, vanilla-friendly mechanic that fits naturally into the game and saves every builder a trip to the swamp.

## Features:

- Converts dirt into mud via cauldron
- Cauldron loses one water level per use
- Smoke particles and sound effects
- Stack-friendly — converts the entire stack in one click
